Independent VAE reconstruction follows per-time MLP hidden256 layout; deterministic mean-latent inference differs from published code stochastic sampling.

design_choices: TimeMLP replaces unspecified U-Net parameterization; fixed standard Gaussian replaces paper learnable Gaussian. Neither is author equivalent.
Literal equation 12 only: data/prior independently sampled at uniform time. Aligned constant fields can attain zero cosine loss; loss does not establish bijectivity or distribution matching.
Paper Eq.11 applies a univariate inverse-function argument to multidimensional time-dependent vectors. This is retained as a documented theoretical concern, not silently repaired.
Euler backward integration over learned reverse field, valid continuous-change-of-variable sign. Dopri5 and exact paper preprocessing/threshold/point-adjustment protocols remain pending.
